title: OLS Projection
text: OLS predictions are the projection of Y onto the column space of X. This means $$Y_{hat}$$ is in col(X), and the residual $$r$$ $$=$$ Y - $$Y_{hat}$$ is orthogonal to col(X).

title: Decompose Y
text: Write Y $$=$$ $$Y_{hat}$$ + $$r$$. Since $$Y_{hat}$$ lies in col(X), and $$r$$ is orthogonal to col(X), $$r$$ is orthogonal to $$Y_{hat}$$.

title: Dot Product Check
text: Using Y $$=$$ $$Y_{hat}$$ + $$r$$ and $$r$$ orthogonal to $$Y_{hat}$$, what is Y dot $$Y_{hat}$$ equal to?

title: Rule Out Both Simple Relationships
text: Since Y dot $$Y_{hat}$$ equals ||Y_hat||**2 in general, Y is not guaranteed to be orthogonal to $$Y_{hat}$$. Since Y may also include a residual component outside $$\operatorname{span}\left(Y_{hat}\right)$$, Y is not guaranteed to be in the span of $$Y_{hat}$$ either.
